boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 105 wraps polyomino bricks around a glowing purple 2×2 square and gives you exactly one shot to break through — a red demolition bar on the right wall. Spend that bar on the wrong cluster and the purple square stays trapped forever. The solve is a packing extraction: clear the top counters and yellow 2×2 first, then aim the red bar at the upper red cluster to free the exit path.
landmarks: Block Out Level 105 wraps polyomino bricks around a glowing purple 2×2 square and gives you exactly one shot to break through — a red demolition bar on the right wall.
Spend that bar on the wrong cluster and the purple square stays trapped forever.
The solve is a packing extraction: clear the top counters and yellow 2×2 first, then aim the red bar at the upper red cluster to free the exit path.

quickTips: Fire the red demolition bar at the start — it only works once.
Move the yellow 2x2 out before trying to exit the purple `1` square.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Trigger the red right-wall bar to break the upper red cluster before any other moves.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Slide the left purple L-piece upward to open space around the center yellow 2x2.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Move the green L on the right side down so the purple `1` square has a clear bottom lane.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Shift the yellow 2x2 out through the top exits to unbox the purple `1` square.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Send the purple `1` square out through the bottom exit to satisfy the top counter.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Clear the remaining blue horizontal piece and pink cluster to finish the top `2` counter.

failurePoints: Spending the red demolition bar on the bottom pink cluster instead of the upper red one.
Trying to slide the purple `1` square before the yellow 2x2 beside it has cleared.
